name: EWM 中的同步收货 - 外部采购 (7VC)
name_en: Synchronous Goods Receipts in EWM - External Procurement (7VC)
description_en_html:
Overview

In this process, packed goods received from suppliers based on standard purchase orders are posted via synchronous goods receipt with the Fiori App ‘Post Goods Movement’ (transaction MIGO). The packaging proposal may be changed in MIGO. Here the Unified Package Builder (UPB) is getting a packaging proposal from packaging specification. You may execute mixed goods receipts for non warehouse-managed storage location and EWM-managed storage locations in one posting.

Key Process Flow

  • Create Purchase Order
  • Process Goods Receipt
  • Check Material Document (Optional)
  • Warehouse Management Monitor Handling
  • Move Pallets from Staging Area to Handover Point (Optional)
  • Putaway of Products from the Handover Point to the High Rack Pallet Buffer (Optional)

Business Benefits

The synchronous goods receipt postings for external procurement reduces the number of documents since there are no inbound deliveries needed. Another advantage of this enhanced integration is the ability to mix goods receipt for MM-IM and EWM storage locations in one posting, as well as mix goods receipt into warehouse stock and to consumption (e.g. cost center). Also, error messages from EWM are now shown to users within the Fiori App when posting goods receipt (transaction MIGO).
description_zh_html:
概览

在此流程中，基于标准采购订单从供应商处收到的已包装货物通过 Fiori 应用“过账货物移动”（事务 MIGO）的同步收货进行过账。可在 MIGO 中更改包装建议。在此，统一包装构建器 (UPB) 从包装规格中获取包装建议。您可以在一个过账中为非仓库管理的存储地点和 EWM 管理的存储地点执行混合收货。

关键流程流

  • 创建采购订单
  • 处理收货
  • 检查物料凭证（可选）
  • 仓库管理监控器处理
  • 将托盘从暂存区域移动到移交点（可选）
  • 从移交点到高架托盘缓冲区的产品入库（可选）

业务优势

外部采购的同步收货过账会减少凭证数量，因为不需要入库交货。此增强集成的另一个优势是在一次过账中混合 MM-IM 和 EWM 存储地点的收货，以及将收货混合到仓库库存和消耗（例如成本中心）。此外，过账收货（事务 MIGO）时，EWM 中的错误消息现在会显示给 Fiori 应用中的用户。
